info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Cross Channel By Param1-spec
info.description: The Cross Channel Authentication Update API enables businesses to modify authentication settings for specific channels based on unique parameters. This operation allows authorized users to adjust configurations for party authentication by providing a designated identifier. Typical consumers of this API include developers building integrated banking solutions or service providers needing to enhance user verification processes. The API ensures secure management and flexibility in cross-channel operations, catering to the dynamic needs of digital banking environments.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the authentication details for a specific party identified by PARTY-600045. Ensure that you provide the necessary data in the request body to update the party's authentication information accordingly.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update specific attributes related to the party authentication process for the designated party ID PARTY-600045. Ensure that the required fields are included according to the schema to successfully process the request.
